name: Jessica K. Hodgins
title: Allen Newell University Professor of Computer Science and Robotics
department: Robotics Institute and Computer Science Department
researchAreas: Reinforcement learning for physical motor skills
fitReason: Her current work connects learned motion control, simulation and real legged robots. This is a strong motor-learning and embodied-control match, with broader graphics/animation research and an additional industry-institute leadership role.

physicalEvidence.summary: The February 2026 Linear Policy Net paper deploys learned time-varying feedback on a physical Spot with an arm, demonstrating pacing with arm motion and coordinated hopping/stroke motions. All authors in that paper are RAI Institute-affiliated, so its hardware is not claimed as CMU equipment. Separately, CMU’s 2025 ASAP report explicitly credits Hodgins and her current PhD advisee Jiashun Wang in a real humanoid project led by LeCAR.

shortVisit.summary: No current external-master’s short-visit invitation was verified on the inspected faculty/home pages. Current CMU supervisees establish an academic mentoring role but do not establish summer 2027 visitor acceptance.

scoreReasons.fit: Strong contemporary learned motor control and sim-to-real robotics, within broader graphics research.

unknowns: RAI’s official leadership page calls her VP, Research while also affirming her CMU professorship. The two roles coexist in the sources; on-campus summer presence and hosting capacity remain unknown.

In the 2026 Spot experiment, learned feedback matrices are precomputed offline and used at runtime. The neural network does not run onboard at every step. Simulated backflips/parkour and the physical pacing/hopping demonstrations must remain distinct.
Most large quantitative smoothness comparisons are simulated. The physical section supplies demonstration evidence without a repeated-trial general success-rate benchmark.

Current-group academic attribution is supported, but visitor access to RAI or LeCAR hardware is unconfirmed. The existing CMU institutional visitor review applies without creating a faculty opportunity.

Summer 2027 acceptance, mentor capacity, exact dates, funding, visitor appointment, and applicable university/immigration approvals remain unconfirmed. Self-funding alone does not establish eligibility.
Public robot research does not confirm current equipment access, a summer 2027 offer or host availability.
